prior_disclosure.text: 2026-08-27's Dream Cycle (docs/dream-cycle/2026-08-27-gist.md, lines ~28-38) found `metaharness doctor`/`diag` silently scaffold instead of erroring, and explicitly flagged it 'a candidate for a future generator-genome or CLI-UX night' without fixing it. Checked LEDGER.md's generator-genome rows for 09-10, 09-15, 09-20, 09-30, 10-05, 10-10, 10-15: all are score.ts/genome-scorers.ts scoring-function bugs; none touched CLI argument parsing. 54 days open before tonight.

hypothesis.text: Given npx metaharness <word> where <word> is a word a CLI user reasonably expects to be a diagnostic/info subcommand, when the candidate guard is applied, then the CLI prints an error and exits 2 instead of silently scaffolding and exiting 0, subject to: (a) --force still scaffolds a project literally named one of these words; (b) the pre-existing fallback test for genuinely novel names stays green unchanged; (c) the known-verb list is single-sourced for both the guard's message and the usage text.

round_1.baseline_command: git stash push -- __tests__/metaharness-subcommands.test.ts packages/create-agent-harness/src/index.ts; rebuild; npx vitest run __tests__/metaharness-subcommands.test.ts
round_1.baseline_result: 8 passed, 9 failed -- 8 new reserved-word assertions fail non-vacuously (expected +0 to be 2), plus 1 pre-existing unrelated failure

independent_critic_round_1.method: Fresh subagent; reverted both files to HEAD~1 independently, rebuilt, ran full suite itself (322/323 files baseline vs candidate), diffed sorted FAIL-line sets -- byte-identical, confirming 0 regressions independently rather than taking the session's word for it. Also live-tested 11 additional plausible words against the pre-candidate and candidate binaries.
caveats: Reserved list real but incomplete -- 11 real `harness <verb>` subcommands (verify, sign, federate, mcp, publish, upgrade, completions, analyze-repo, export-config, oia-manifest, plugin-init) live-verified still silently scaffolding on round 1's build.
--force now carries two meanings (pre-existing 'overwrite target dir' plus new 'scaffold this reserved word anyway') -- narrow but real risk of an unintended silent overwrite.
Guard runs before the --wizard block, which can later set args.name interactively, bypassing the guard -- low real-world risk, real coverage gap.

round_2.live_cli_smoke_test: metaharness doctor and metaharness verify both now exit 2 with no directory created; previously both exited 0 and scaffolded

darwin.reason: Reserved-word guard in CLI argument parsing has no tunable parameter space -- no routing weight, topology, or scorer coefficient; not one of ADR-071's seven approved mutation surfaces. Same classification as 2026-10-19's SDK-validation fix (#419).

flywheel.reason: No corpus, no LLM eval needed -- deterministic CLI argument-parsing fix, fully verified by direct unit/integration test + live CLI smoke test.

reward_hack_check.text: Independent critic read the full diff twice: no pre-existing test weakened, no gold/expected value changed, no threshold altered, no test skipped. The only non-additive-test change is 4 new usage-text lines, verified against runMetaHarnessSubcommand's real switch cases (which do have weight-eft/redblue/flywheel/turn-credit) -- documents reality, does not hide anything.

security_review.text: Change confined to packages/create-agent-harness/src/index.ts, a synchronous argument-parsing path with no new I/O/network/eval. Strictly narrows accepted behavior (blocks an unintended filesystem write that previously happened silently); never loosens an existing check. Reduces attack/confusion surface rather than adding to it.

promotion_gate_self_check.tests_green: 19 new/changed assertions pass; 1 pre-existing unrelated failure unchanged
promotion_gate_self_check.critic_clear: ACCEPT-WITH-CAVEATS, 3 non-blocking (1 closed same night in round 2, 2 disclosed)

disclosed_not_fixed_followups: --force flag now carries two overloaded meanings (overwrite-existing-dir vs. scaffold-reserved-word-anyway) -- a distinct flag would be safer, not introduced tonight to keep the diff minimal.
The reserved-word guard runs before the --wizard block and does not re-check args.name after the wizard sets it interactively.

Pre-existing unrelated test failure: __tests__/metaharness-subcommands.test.ts > 'bare name (back-compat)' expects exit 2 on empty argv but gets 0 -- stale test predating #73's intentional bare-invocation-exits-0 change; not touched tonight.

SCAN (router): index.ts's clearing.sort((a,b)=>a.costPerMTok-b.costPerMTok) and train.ts (x2) never validate costPerMTok/quality for finiteness -- a single NaN candidate silently violates the documented cheapest-candidate contract. No test exercises non-finite cost/quality.

SCAN (turn-credit): one NaN/-Infinity evidence value poisons accumulated/mean/variance for every subsequent turn, not just the bad one; clip() has no isNaN guard; receipt.ts's canon() JSON.stringifies NaN to the string 'null', so a corrupted weight is signed into the 'tamper-evident' receipt as a clean null.
